# Foundit Jobs Scraper & API - Monster India, Gulf & Singapore

> Foundit jobs scraper and API for all nine foundit sites: Monster India (foundit.in), Monster Gulf, Singapore, the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, Hong Kong, Thailand and Vietnam.

## Summary

Foundit Jobs Scraper is an Apify actor that searches all nine foundit job sites, the new name of Monster India, Monster Gulf and Monster's Southeast Asia sites, live and at once, and returns one row per job, newest first: title, company, location, years of experience asked, skills, job type, pay when shown, first-listed date, closing date, country site, listing source and links. On 2026-11-08 the sites listed 450,058 open jobs: India 219,732, Singapore 107,828, the Philippines 39,492, the Gulf 30,909, Malaysia 21,817, Indonesia 11,602, Vietnam 6,923, Thailand 6,194 and Hong Kong 5,561. Each typed place goes to the site that lists it, so India and the Gulf fit in one run, and every job's location is checked, so a city search returns only that city. No login and no key.

Store: https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/foundit-jobs-search
Source: https://github.com/AnshumanAtrey/foundit-jobs-search

## Key features

- All nine sites: foundit.in, founditgulf.com, foundit.sg, foundit.com.ph, foundit.my, foundit.id, foundit.hk, monster.co.th and monster.com.vn, several in one run with no country selector.
- Only jobs in the place you typed: foundit's own search adds nearby cities and remote jobs to a city search; this actor drops them. Bangalore also finds Bengaluru and Gurgaon finds Gurugram, by foundit's own place list.
- Years of experience as numbers on every row that states them, and a filter that takes 3, 2-5, 5+ or fresher.
- Newest first by the date foundit's job page gives Google (first listed), with the renewal date apart as refreshedAt.
- Remote jobs read from foundit's work-from-home type and from Remote in the location or title, where most syndicated jobs say it.
- Native or syndicated on every row (jobSource), with the original apply link.
- Job link check: each pasted link, old monsterindia.com links included, comes back open, closed or not found.

## Input keys

- Job titles to find (searchTerms): one per line; a job matches when its title has every word.
- Where the job is (location): city, state, country or region; each goes to the site that lists it; Remote alone asks for remote jobs, next to other places it narrows nothing; empty searches all nine sites.
- Experience (experienceYears): 3, 2-5, 5+ (5 or more) or fresher (0); jobs whose range overlaps it; jobs that state no experience are left out.
- Posted in the last (postedWithin): 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days, 30 days, any time, or your own period.
- Number of jobs (maxJobs): 100 by default, 0 for every match (foundit shows up to 9,600 per search and site).
- Full details (includeDetails): adds the description, every place with its state and country, the qualifications and pay as numbers.
- Remote or hybrid (workType): remote or hybrid.
- Job type (employmentType): full-time, part-time or contract.
- Leave out words (excludeTerms): drops jobs whose title has these words.
- Match descriptions (searchDescriptions): keeps every job foundit's own search finds for the words in skills and description.
- Job links to check (jobUrls): checks links instead of searching.

A run that saves nothing says why: the one filter that alone left out jobs that had the words ("the years of experience alone left out 242"), or that foundit has no job with the words inside the other filters, or that no title had the words.

## Pricing

PAY_PER_EVENT model, platform usage included:

- Run start: $0.0063, once per run (once per GB of memory, so once at the default 512 MB)
- Job: $0.000017 per saved job ($0.017 per 1,000), and per checked link that is closed or not found
- Job with details: $0.000059 per saved job with full details on ($0.059 per 1,000)

Foundit Jobs Scraper's Apify Store header, "from $0.011 / 1,000 jobs", shows the lowest discount-tier price, the GOLD price, without the run start. FREE users (Apify's Free plan) pay the prices above; BRONZE (Starter) pays $0.000016 a job and $0.000057 with details; SILVER (Scale) $0.000014 and $0.000044; GOLD (Business) and above $0.000011 and $0.000035. The run start is $0.0063 on every plan.

Typical costs (Free plan price):

- 100 newest jobs: $0.008
- 100 jobs with full details: $0.0122
- 1,000 jobs: $0.0233

Apify's free $5 monthly credit covers about 600 runs of 100 jobs.

## Speed

A search of 100 jobs takes a few seconds: one call per site and 100 jobs. Measured on Apify on 2026-11-08 at the default 512 MB: the 100 newest jobs from all nine sites in 3.3 s, the 1,000 newest in 13 s, 50 jobs with full details in 27 s. Measured locally: 5,000 jobs in under a minute, every job foundit shows on all nine sites (72,668) in 7 minutes. Full details read each saved job once more, about 2 jobs a second, because foundit refuses an address that calls too fast.

## How to call it

- Apify API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/anshumanatrey~foundit-jobs-search/run-sync-get-dataset-items with the input as JSON and the header Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>. It returns the rows and waits up to 300 seconds, so start bigger runs with a client.
- Python and JavaScript: the apify-client package, actor anshumanatrey/foundit-jobs-search.
- n8n: the Apify node, Run an Actor and get dataset. Make: the Apify app's Run an Actor and Get Dataset Items modules.
- MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=anshumanatrey/foundit-jobs-search, signed in with Apify or with Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>.

## When to use

- The user wants jobs from foundit or Monster India, a foundit jobs API, or Monster Gulf or Monster Singapore jobs.
- The user wants new jobs by title, city, years of experience and date in India, the Gulf or Southeast Asia, on a schedule.
- The user wants several countries in one run, such as India and the UAE.
- The user wants to check whether foundit job links are still open.

## When NOT to use

- The user needs jobs that exist only on other Indian boards (Naukri, Indeed, Shine): use an actor for that board or a multi-board feed.
- The user needs pay on most jobs: foundit shows pay on about 40% of Singapore jobs and 1% or less elsewhere.
- The user needs every job of a broad search on one site: foundit shows the 9,600 newest per search and site.
- The user runs many searches of one to six jobs: the $0.0063 run start makes those cost more here than on data_daemon/foundit-jobs-scraper ($0.0008 a job plus a $0.001 start) or scrapewise/foundit-scraper ($0.001 a job).

## Sample input

```json
{
  "searchTerms": ["python developer"],
  "location": ["Bangalore", "Pune"],
  "experienceYears": "3",
  "postedWithin": "7 days",
  "maxJobs": 100
}
```

## Sample output (one record)

From a local run of the release candidate on 2026-11-08: python developer in Bangalore.

```json
{
  "title": "Senior Python Developer - (Python with SSH mandatory), 6+yrs,Bangalore, Immediate Joiners only",
  "company": "Global Technologies",
  "location": "Bengaluru, India",
  "employmentType": "full-time",
  "salary": null,
  "postedAt": "2026-11-07T17:21:28Z",
  "expiresAt": "2026-12-06T18:30:00Z",
  "jobUrl": "https://www.foundit.in/job/senior-python-developer-python-with-ssh-mandatory-6yrs-bangalore-immediate-joiners-only-global-technologies-bengaluru-bangalore-india-69753511",
  "status": "open",
  "platform": "foundit",
  "jobId": "69753511",
  "experienceMin": 6,
  "experienceMax": 8,
  "site": "foundit.in",
  "skills": ["Report Generation", "SSH Paramiko", "log parsing", "C++", "Robot Framework", "Python", "Pytest"],
  "employerType": "company",
  "jobSource": "syndicated",
  "refreshedAt": "2026-11-07T17:21:28Z"
}
```

## Differentiators vs alternatives

- vs themineworks/foundit-jobs-scraper ($0.0025 per job, $0.002 on Starter): foundit.in only and one city per run; this actor costs less from 4 jobs a run (100 jobs: $0.008 against $0.25 on the Free plan) and searches all nine sites.
- vs memo23/foundit-jobs-scraper ($0.00599 per job + $0.005 start): four sites, one per run, with coordinates and paid add-ons; this actor costs less on every run and covers the Gulf, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Thailand and Vietnam.
- vs scrapewise/foundit-scraper ($0.001 per job, no start fee): six sites, one per run, cheaper on runs of 6 jobs or fewer; this actor searches several sites in one run and keeps only jobs in the place typed.
